test_cases.name: Simple Greeting Bypass
test_cases.expected_response_contains: Hello! I am Dr. Sara Hegy's executive coaching assistant
test_cases.verification_criteria: Immediate static response; zero network calls to Ollama embedding or PostgreSQL.

test_cases.name: Relevant Framework Query (Completion with Integrity)
test_cases.input_query: How do I practice Completion with Integrity when closing projects?
test_cases.verification_criteria: Framework record retrieved with similarity >= 0.70; response grounded in conceptual definition.

test_cases.name: Relevant Communication / Style Query
test_cases.input_query: How should I speak to an executive who feels overwhelmed by micromanagement?
test_cases.verification_criteria: Voice chunk retrieved with similarity >= 0.65; response reflects Dr. Sara Hegy's cadence.

test_cases.name: Dual-Stream Qualifying Query (Framework + Voice)
test_cases.input_query: How can an executive use the Table and Shoulder test to regulate cognitive load and avoid micromanaging?
test_cases.verification_criteria: Both framework (>= 0.70) and voice (>= 0.65) records retrieved; generation prompt incorporates both Section A and Section B.

test_cases.name: Framework-Only Retrieval (Synthetic High Framework / Low Voice)
test_cases.input_query: Define the structured steps and operational mechanisms of the Table and Shoulder test.
test_cases.verification_criteria: Framework retrieved; voice stream empty; generation prompt clearly notes absence of voice samples.

test_cases.name: Voice-Only Retrieval (Style Query Without Specific Framework)
test_cases.input_query: How does Dr. Sara describe protecting cognitive bandwidth and executive energy?
test_cases.verification_criteria: Voice samples retrieved; framework stream empty; generation notes partial evidence limitation.

test_cases.name: Completely Unrelated Query (Zero Results Gate)
test_cases.input_query: What is the optimal fertilizer ratio for growing hydroponic tomatoes in winter?
test_cases.expected_response_exact: No documented coaching frameworks match this topic.
test_cases.verification_criteria: Both SQL queries return 0 rows above threshold; Hard Gate halts workflow before generation LLM; returns exact mandatory fallback string.

test_cases.name: Framework Threshold Boundary Rejection (< 0.70)
test_cases.input_query: What are general agile software sprint estimation metrics?
test_cases.verification_criteria: SQL similarity filter (1 - distance >= 0.70) strictly drops candidate framework chunks scoring < 0.70.

test_cases.name: Voice Threshold Boundary Rejection (< 0.65)
test_cases.verification_criteria: SQL similarity filter (1 - distance >= 0.65) strictly drops voice chunks scoring < 0.65.

test_cases.name: Invalid Embedding Vector Rejection
test_cases.verification_criteria: Validate Query Vector node catches missing, truncated, or non-finite vector before issuing SQL queries.
